FLORIDA

Venezuelan Bribe

Suspect Arrested

A businessman wanted in the U.S. for allegedly paying bribes to top Venezuelan officials in exchange for lucrative state contracts in Venezuela has been taken into custody. Alvaro Pulido was indicted in Miami federal court in 2019 and again in 2021 as part of an investigation into his long-time business partner, Alex Saab, a onetime ally of ousted President Nicolas Maduro.

—Associated Press
